plan.title: Service PR to PO via Technical + RFQ

steps.note: Enable eRFX projects for the PR-created event.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation and publishing.
Provide the mandatory event title.
Commit the 30-minute bidding schedule.
Invite the QA vendors mapped by the product configuration without inventing supplier names.
Publish the completed Technical + RFQ event.
Verify that publishing reached a real project page.
Have the first QA vendor answer the technical stage and submit a quote of 100 per activity.
Verify that the first vendor's bid was accepted.
Have the next QA vendor answer the technical stage and submit a lower quote of 90 per activity.
Verify that the second vendor's bid was accepted.
Wait for bidding to end before evaluation, QCS review, and awarding.
Open the buyer comparison grid after both bids are available.
Verify that the second bidder, representing Vendor B in the bid order, is ranked L1.
Award the full quantity to the lowest bidder.
Verify that the award proposal was created and submitted.

args.remark: Approved for service PR award to the lowest bidder.

steps.note: Approve the submitted proposal with the required approver remark.
Complete the approved award and create the purchase order(s).
Verify that one PO contains the two awarded activity lines.
Navigate to the events list to verify the event is available in history.
Open the Events History tab.
Verify that this plan's event appears in event history.
